card.name: Scattered words in research citations
card.fires_on: Small linking words, commas and word starts inside academic titles, author lists and study descriptions, such as 'in' after 'mean-level change' or a comma between author names.

modes.label: Words inside paper titles
modes.description: A linking word or title word within a research paper title or abstract heading.
modes.example: Patterns of mean-level change<< in>> personality traits across the life course: a

modes.label: Author list punctuation
modes.description: A comma or 'and' between author names or after a citation name.
modes.example: - Peter E. Rossi, Greg M. Allenby<<,>> and Robert McCulloch, Bayesian Statistics

modes.label: Pre- words in study settings
modes.description: The start 'pre' in words like pre-marketing or pretrial.
